name: skim-city
description: SKIM CITY — plastering CRM, booking and payments. Taking the rough to the smooth.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.build: npm run sync:types && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.build:preview: npm run sync:types && npm --prefix web run build:preview && node scripts/build-preview.mjs
